findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed there is an accumulation of dust in the following locations: (1) walk-in cooler fans; and (2) ceiling vent above the storage shelves between the double door cooler and oven in the kitchen. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Ensure that the fans and vent are cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
Foods are not cooled using time and temperature criteria. Vacuum sealed bags that are not opened are placed on sheet pans after lunch and placed on a counter to cool. (10 minutes according to manager) The sheet trays of bags are then placed into the freezer. The manager states that they have been doing this for 7 years. The facility does not have a plan in place to cool vacuum sealed bags. Inspector has reached out to her food program director. The department will look into this process further. Until such time please follow the cooling SOP for the facility.

3-501.15: (A) Cooling shall be accomplished with time and temperature criteria by using following methods: FOOD in shallow pans, Separating FOOD into small portions, using rapid cooling EQUIPMENT, stirring food in container placed in ice bath, containers facilitating heat transfer, adding ice, other effective methods. P (B) When placed in cooling or cold holding EQUIPMENT, FOOD containers shall be: arranged to maximize heat transfer through container walls, loosely covered or uncovered, and during cooling period. C

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
The facility uses cardboard boxes to hold bagged bread sticks and buns. Cardboard is not a smooth or cleanable surface. Use cleanable containers to store food. 

4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a can of grape jelly with a severe dent along the upper seam of the can. The can has been stocked in and date marked. The can was removed during the inspection. Corrected on site. No follow-up required. Ensure that cans are checked for dents when stocked in and removed from stock when dents are observed. 

3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

750-830a Dish machines shall be properly installed and maintained in good repair. Dish machines shall be operated in accordance with the manufacturers instructions. Automatic dispensers and liquid injectors, if any, shall be properly installed and maintained.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the walls in the kitchen at the handsink and around the next wall to have holes and gaps  in spots. Cover the holes or seal with caulk. 
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food prepartion areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbant, and easily cleanable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleanable surface.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The shelves in the walk-in cooler are chipping.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
Sand and paint the shelves so they do not begin to corrode.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
There was no hot water in the kitchen or bathroom handsinks. 
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.
The hot water mixing valve to the system supplying water to these two sinks was just replaced.  The water was beginning to warm up during the inspection.

750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.
Provide a covered wastebasket in the restroom.
